description: This file defines a Flask-based health check route using Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and MethodView. It sets up an endpoint at '/' to return a health status message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask view class that provides a health check endpoint responding with a JSON message indicating system health.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check endpoint and returns a JSON message indicating health status.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", __name__, url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route")$/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", __name__, url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route")
